meta.source: Built from the SoloR designer brief (Oct 18, 2026) and the live app's Tailwind tokens (globals.css).

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Customer: warm near-black so the meat photo carries the colour. Counter: warm paper.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Post cards, sheets, cart rows.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Image placeholder while loading, shop-mark disc, pressed rows, input fields.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers, 10% ink. Never for meaning.

tokens.name: line-gold
tokens.usage: The thin gold frame around a post card and the gold rule of the butcher note.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on ground, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, price per kg, timestamps, on ground and surface.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Small accents only: eyebrows, links, aging chip text, the shop-mark ring, the confirmation tick. As text on ground and surface.

tokens.name: gold-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the aging chip and of the reserved badge's halo.

tokens.name: bordeaux
tokens.usage: The one action colour: add to cart, reserve and pay, the R of the logo. As a fill under on-bordeaux text. In the counter UI it also marks a new order.

tokens.name: bordeaux-press
tokens.usage: Pressed state of bordeaux buttons.

tokens.name: bordeaux-glow
tokens.usage: Glow behind the primary button and the soft wash at the top of the feed. Never text.

tokens.name: on-bordeaux
tokens.usage: Text and icons on bordeaux fills.

tokens.name: state-new
tokens.usage: The '3 new cuts' pill: a fill, with on-state-new text.

tokens.name: on-state-new
tokens.usage: Text on state-new.

tokens.name: state-partial
tokens.usage: '5 of 8 left' chip fill (with on-bordeaux text). Same hue as the action on purpose: scarcity and buying are the same story.

tokens.name: state-reserved
tokens.usage: 'Reserved' badge fill on the photo, with on-state-reserved text. Gold = someone is holding it.

tokens.name: on-state-reserved
tokens.usage: Text on state-reserved.

tokens.name: state-sold
tokens.usage: The 'Sold out' stamp ink, cart rows that sold, unavailable text. Always with the word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: state-error
tokens.usage: Form errors and failed actions, as text on ground and surface.

tokens.name: state-success
tokens.usage: 'Open now', ready-for-pickup, positive confirmations, as text or a 6px dot. Always with a word.

tokens.name: status-new
tokens.usage: Counter: new order card stripe and badge fill (on-bordeaux text).

tokens.name: status-prep
tokens.usage: Counter: in preparation. Fill in customer (dark text); text and stripe in counter.

tokens.name: status-ready
tokens.usage: Counter: ready for pickup. Text and stripe.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind bottom sheets and over sold photos.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Splash, login, order confirmed. One per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles, shop name on the shop page.

styles.name: cut-name
styles.usage: Cut · breed in a post. The most important line in the app.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Section heads, shop groups in the cart, sheet titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: שומן לבן ויציב, שיוש עדין לאורך כל הנתח.
styles.usage: Running text, butcher note, form values.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body, button labels, shop name in a post header.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Price per kg, meta lines, helper text.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Small gold heads above a block. Always in gold.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: The price in the order bar and cart totals. Tabular figures, always LTR-isolated.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label, chip inner gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips; between media tiles.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Rows inside a post; list row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter; post card inner padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between posts in the feed.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between screen sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top of login and confirmation screens.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Media thumbnails under the main photo, cart row photo.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Main post photo, inputs, counter buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Post card, cart group card.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, new-cuts pill, cart bar.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Post card and cart bar lift.

tokens.name: shadow-action
tokens.usage: Glow under the primary bordeaux button only.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for anything tappable in the customer app.

tokens.name: tap-counter
tokens.usage: Minimum button height in the counter UI (wet hands, read from a distance).

tokens.name: screen-max
tokens.usage: App column width.

tokens.name: header-h
tokens.usage: Fixed top bar.

tokens.name: nav-h
tokens.usage: Bottom tab bar (two tabs).
